messages:
Noah (CSM): Kicking off Aether Labs onboarding. Outcome: ship a pilot inference endpoint for knowledge-assistant workflows in 30 days and produce a renewal recommendation pack. Need to align owners, measurable success criteria, a 6-week cadence, and a light feedback loop.
Pri (Solutions Eng): I can own API integration and perf baselines. Quick Q: do they need dedicated capacity or private VPC?
Riley (Aether Labs - Eng): We want Dedicated for predictable latency but can start hosted for dev. Also legal requires an embeddings retention policy and audit logs.
Tess (Onboard PM): Proposed 6-week cadence: Week 0: access, infra prep, kickoff; Week 1: auth + example app + smoke perf; Week 2: prompt tuning + quality evals; Week 3: internal beta with 5 users; Week 4-5: external pilot & feedback; Week 6: go/no-go and renewal recommendation.
Noah (CSM): Success criteria: 1) p95 inference latency < 280ms on Dedicated; 2) 4 core workflows automated end-to-end; 3) sample prompts meet quality threshold on 80% of cases; 4) pilot satisfaction >= 7/10; 5) security sign-off for retention and logs. I'll maintain the checklist.
onboard-bot: Workspace created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Aether-77 (restricted)
Pri (Solutions Eng): Action items: post a prompt bank and a smoke-test script by tomorrow EOD; I'll also include a quantized fallback model for cost SLOs.
Riley (Aether Labs - Eng): We'll share Okta metadata and the clinician-like user roster today. Note risk: legal may ask for encryption-at-rest attestation which could take 3-5 days.
Tess (Onboard PM): I'll publish a one-page risk register (Auth delay, legal retention sign-off, pilot user availability) and will update it thrice weekly.
Noah (CSM): Feedback plan: short 6-question form after each pilot session (accuracy, usefulness, speed, trust, ease of use, overall). We'll instrument time-saved where possible.
Pri (Solutions Eng): Quick curl to validate integration:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-dedicated-mpt","prompt":"Summarize document:","max_tokens":150}'
```
Use this to check headers and response shape.
Riley (Aether Labs - Eng): We'll run the smoke tonight and post results here. Training proposal: Thurs 2pm PT. Works?
Noah (CSM): Thurs 2pm PT works for me. Owners recap: Pri -> integration & perf; Tess -> timeline & risk register; Noah -> success metrics & survey; Riley -> infra, Okta, users. If blockers pop up, ping this thread or DM. :rocket:
